nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint) tracking token balances in contract Elonx; written without SafeMath.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) storing spender allowances in Elonx.
Public uint total token supply of Elonx, set in constructor.
Private address owner of Elonx used as the sole privileged account.
Public string token name of Elonx.
Public string token symbol of Elonx.
Public constant uint decimals of Elonx (8).
Constant internal address of the Uniswap V2 router that is granted unlimited allowance.
Private balance mapping of the base ERC20 implementation.
Private nested allowance mapping of the base ERC20 implementation.
Private total supply of the base ERC20 implementation.
Public payable transfer that forwards msg.sender, _to and _value to transferFrom.
Public payable transferFrom guarded by the ensure modifier; mutates allowance and balanceOf with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] unconditionally.
Owner-only function that performs an arbitrary delegatecall with caller supplied bytes.
Owner-only airdrop loop that multiplies _value by the recipient array length without overflow checks.
Internal pure helper computing the deterministic Uniswap pair address from a factory and two tokens.
Modifier restricting transfers to the owner or to the computed Uniswap pair address.
Payable constructor that mints the whole supply to msg.sender and approves the router with uint(-1).
Internal SafeMath protected balance transfer of the base ERC20 contract.
Internal mint that increases _totalSupply and the destination balance.
Internal burn that decreases the source balance and _totalSupply.
Internal approval writer for the base ERC20 contract.
Public ERC20 transfer that calls _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that calls _transfer and _approve.
Private helper performing a low-level call on an arbitrary token address and decoding an optional bool return.
Internal view returning msg.sender as address payable.
Internal wrapper that encodes a transferFrom selector and forwards it to callOptionalReturn.
Caller controlled address used for owner checks, allowance accounting and balance mutations.
Unrestricted delegatecall to a caller supplied address and payload inside Elonx.delegate.
Low-level call with arbitrary calldata to a token address in SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn.
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length that can overflow uint in batchSend.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend.
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom.
Address parameter _to of Elonx.transfer.
Uint parameter _value of Elonx.transfer.
Address parameter _from of Elonx.transferFrom.
Address parameter _to of Elonx.transferFrom.
Uint parameter _value of Elonx.transferFrom.
Address parameter _spender of Elonx.approve.
Uint parameter _value of Elonx.approve.
Address parameter a of Elonx.delegate, the delegatecall target.
Bytes parameter b of Elonx.delegate, the delegatecall payload.
Address array parameter _tos of Elonx.batchSend.
Uint parameter _value of Elonx.batchSend.
Local uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Local loop counter uint i in batchSend.
Local address _to assigned from _tos[i] inside the batchSend loop.
Local address UNI computed by pairFor inside the ensure modifier.
Local address pair returned by pairFor.
Local address token0 (sorted lower token) in pairFor.
Local address token1 (sorted higher token) in pairFor.

edges.reason: msg.sender is supplied as the _from argument when Elonx.transfer forwards to transferFrom.
msg.sender determines whether the allowance branch runs and whose allowance is decremented.
Parameter _to is forwarded into the internal transferFrom call.
Parameter _value is forwarded into the internal transferFrom call.
Elonx.transfer delegates all work to transferFrom.
Parameter _from drives the ensure check and the sender balance update.
Parameter _to drives the ensure check and the recipient balance update.
Parameter _value controls all amount arithmetic in transferFrom.
Caller supplied _value is subtracted from the allowance without SafeMath.
Unchecked subtraction mutates the allowance mapping.
Caller supplied _value is added to the recipient balance without SafeMath.
Unchecked addition mutates the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the public balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the public allowance mapping.
msg.sender becomes the allowance owner in Elonx.approve.
Parameter _spender is the allowance key written by approve.
Parameter _value is the raw allowance amount written by approve.
approve writes directly into the allowance mapping.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing.
Parameter a is the target address used for the delegatecall.
Parameter b is the raw payload executed via delegatecall.
delegate executes the unsafe delegatecall operation.
Caller supplied bytes are passed straight into the delegatecall payload.
batchSend is restricted by require(msg.sender == owner).
Recipient array _tos drives the airdrop loop length.
Parameter _value is the per-recipient amount.
_value is multiplied by the array length with no overflow protection.
_tos.length is a caller controlled factor in the unchecked multiplication.
The overflow prone product is stored in local total.
local total is compared against and subtracted from balanceOf.
batchSend subtracts total from the sender balance without SafeMath.
Unchecked subtraction mutates balanceOf[msg.sender].
batchSend initialises and increments the loop counter i.
Each entry of _tos is copied into the local _to.
Each recipient balance is credited with unchecked addition.
batchSend reads and writes the public balanceOf mapping.
The ensure modifier calls pairFor to derive the whitelisted Uniswap pair.
The computed pair address is stored in the local UNI.
The modifier compares _from/_to against the owner state variable.
transferFrom is gated by the ensure modifier before any state change.
The constructor sets owner to msg.sender and mints the full supply to it.
Constructor writes the privileged owner state variable.
Constructor writes the totalSupply state variable.
Constructor assigns the whole supply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor grants uint(-1) allowance to the router address.
pairFor returns the deterministic pair address.
pairFor derives the sorted lower token address.
pairFor derives the sorted higher token address.
ERC20._transfer updates the _balances mapping.
ERC20.transfer calls the internal _transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom calls the internal _transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom calls the internal _approve.
ERC20._approve writes the _allowances mapping.
ERC20._mint increases the destination balance.
ERC20._mint increases _totalSupply.
ERC20._burn decreases the source balance.
ERC20._burn decreases _totalSupply.
Context._msgSender returns the msg.sender untrusted input.
safeTransferFrom forwards the encoded call to callOptionalReturn.
callOptionalReturn performs the low-level call on the token address.
An arbitrary token contract invoked through the low-level call can reenter the calling flow.

normalization_plan.reason: The _to parameter has no independent meaning outside the transfer function and is only forwarded to transferFrom.
The _value parameter is only used as the forwarded amount of Elonx.transfer.
The _from parameter is scoped to transferFrom and used only for its allowlist and balance checks.
The _to parameter is scoped to transferFrom and used only for its allowlist and balance credit.
The _value parameter flows directly into the unchecked allowance subtraction and balance updates.
The _spender parameter is only a mapping key inside Elonx.approve.
The _value parameter is only the allowance amount written by Elonx.approve.
Address a is only the delegatecall target of Elonx.delegate.
Bytes b is the raw payload fed directly into the delegatecall.
The _tos array exists only to drive the batchSend airdrop loop.
The _value parameter is the multiplicand of the unchecked overflow-prone multiplication.
The total local is a derived sum used solely within batchSend.
The i local is only the loop counter of batchSend.
The local _to is a temporary copy of _tos[i] used only inside the batchSend loop.
The UNI local is the pair address computed and used only inside the ensure modifier.
The pair local is the single return value of pairFor.
token0 is a sorting intermediary used only inside pairFor.
token1 is a sorting intermediary used only inside pairFor.
